errors.text_span: listed alphabetically from 'Gemini 2.5 Flash (No Code)' to 'Nemotron-Super-V1'
errors.evidence: The models on the horizontal axis are not listed in alphabetical order. For example, 'o4-mini' precedes 'GPT-4.1', but 'Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct' precedes 'Llama 4 Scout'.

errors.text_span: with each model represented by individual bars
errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart where each model is represented by a group of up to five bars, not a single individual bar.
The tick labels on the vertical axis increment by 20 (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100), not by 10.

errors.text_span: Each model has three bars representing the success rate under three equivalence perturbation conditions
errors.evidence: The chart shows groups of up to five bars per model, not three. The description completely omits the 'Seed' and 'Equivalence-All-Easy' categories shown in the legend.

errors.text_span: 'Equivalence-One-Easy,' 'Equivalence-One-Hard,' and 'Equivalence-All-Hard,' visually distinguished by color—light blue, medium blue, and dark blue, respectively
errors.evidence: This description is both incomplete and incorrect. It misses two categories from the legend ('Seed' and 'Equivalence-All-Easy'). Additionally, the color mapping is wrong; for instance, 'Equivalence-All-Hard' is the lightest blue, not dark blue.

errors.text_span: exhibiting success rates generally between 20% and 60%
errors.evidence: The 'Equivalence-All-Hard' success rates have a wider range. For example, 'Llama 4 Scout' is near 1% and 'Gemini 2.5 Flash (Code)' is approximately 66%. The stated range of 20-60% is inaccurate.
The range for 'Equivalence-One-Easy' is incorrect. The lowest value, for 'Llama 4 Scout', is approximately 12%, which is well below the stated 40% minimum.
The range for 'Equivalence-One-Hard' is incorrect. The lowest value, for 'Llama 4 Scout', is approximately 9%, which is well below the stated 30% minimum.

errors.text_span: 'Gemini 2.5 Flash (No Code)' has success rates of approximately 40%, 55%, and 35% for 'Equivalence-One-Easy,' 'Equivalence-One-Hard,' and 'Equivalence-All-Hard,' respectively
errors.evidence: The reported values for 'Gemini 2.5 Flash (No Code)' are all incorrect. The chart shows approximate rates of 32% ('Equivalence-One-Easy'), 25% ('Equivalence-One-Hard'), and 4% ('Equivalence-All-Hard').
The reported values for 'Llama 4 Scout' are all incorrect. The chart shows approximate rates of 12% ('Equivalence-One-Easy'), 9% ('Equivalence-One-Hard'), and 1% ('Equivalence-All-Hard').

errors.text_span: All bars are similarly shaded in blue
errors.evidence: This statement is misleading. While all bars use a blue color palette, the five distinct shades are crucial for differentiating the five data categories as defined in the legend. Stating they are 'similarly shaded' downplays this key visual encoding.
